input.free_text_description: This system is an authentication platform that serves User, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for login failures clearing handler, in memory login failures manager, login failures counting handler. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a User, I want to interact with security functionality, so that I can accomplish my security-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with testing functionality, so that I can accomplish my testing-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with validation functionality, so that I can accomplish my validation-related tasks.
